change: All slot data/metadata/tag, tag verdict and resident verdict cache updates use original step, while original public fault/abort/reset/flush priorities, pointers, active/output validity, commit, packet events and retirement are byte-preserved by literal inverse.
quarantine_argument: Before a fault sampling edge no stored state differs, so current public combinational masking and retirement inputs match.
A fault edge may write new slot contents in V12; the unchanged control aborts and clears occupied/committed pointers and public output validity at that same edge.
Following a new epoch, every occupied slot is overwritten with candidate/reference-identical data and metadata before possible commit.

Stale per-tag verdict or cache bits can differ for uncommitted/invalid slots; every packet completion assigns its current tag verdict and broadcasts to initialized matching slots before public retirement. The full miter checks only committed cache verdict and all occupied data/metadata.
Tag generation, extended ring-span reuse rules, last-writer ordering and CRC/nullification/event policy are unchanged.
evidence_limits: Finite initialized binary literal algebra plus default-profile full top-level cycle miter and fault controls. This is not exhaustive arbitrary hidden-state/four-state proof or full4118 profile; native timing must be measured independently.
